description: The design package schema every view reads from, plus the cost and part-count helpers. The authority for what a part, connection, assembly node and instruction step are. Read this before judging whether a component is using the data correctly.

Derives physical dimensions, shape class and colour for every part from its category and name. The single source of truth for sizes — the part illustrations, the 3D scene and the STL export all read from it, so a change here moves all three.
Design tokens for both themes and the custom component classes. Relevant to any styling change: classes here must sit inside @layer components or they silently outrank Tailwind utilities.
Binary STL writer. The format contract is that file length equals 84 + 50 * triangle count; check any change against it.
What the project claims to do and, in the Status and limits section, what it explicitly does not. A PR that changes behaviour described here should update it.
